summary: The diff adds a single new markdown report (TIER2_AUDIT_FIX_REPORT_2026-07-26.md) documenting disposition of the 14 real superboss_rejected_audit_fail tasks; it contains no code, schema, auth, or workflow changes, consistent with a tier1 (additive/docs) classification. The 11 skipped-moot / 3 corrective-fix-dispatched / 0 could-not-process accounting is internally consistent (11+3=14) and each disposition includes a specific, checkable justification rather than a vague claim.
